description: Represents a single cell within a spreadsheet sheet. Stores raw value, formula, computed display value, style, and data type.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: The raw value stored in the cell.

properties.name: Formula
properties.description: The formula expression (e.g. =SUM(A1:A10)). Null if no formula.

properties.name: DisplayValue
properties.description: The computed or formatted display value. Null until evaluated.

properties.name: Style
properties.description: The visual style of the cell.

properties.name: DataType
properties.description: The data type of the cell value.
